name: Azersoul (Forge Ifrit Variant)
body:
Descended from azers, usually through dwarven bloodlines, these ifrits are known for being unusually dour and taciturn among their kind. Nevertheless, they are loyal allies who are proud of their work—both at the forge and on the battlefield.

Alternate Ability Modifiers +2 Str, +2 Wis, –2 Cha

Alternate Spell-Like Ability You gain heat metal as a spell-like ability.

Hammer Fire (Ex) You are proficient with light hammers and warhammers. If the hafts of these weapons are made of metal, you can heat these weapons while wielding them in order to deal 1 extra point of fire damage with them. This fire damage is not multiplied on a critical hit. The weapons cool to normal temperature after they leave your hand, or after you make a throwing attack with them. This trait replaces the base ifrit’s fire affinity.
